title: Build parallel merge publisher queue
summary: Build a serialized publisher queue that compares worker diffs, validates outputs, commits safe merges, and reroutes conflicts after parallel worktree execution.

goal.outcome: Parallel worker outputs are merged through a serialized publisher queue that checks diffs, enforces validation proof, commits safely, and routes conflicts back to workers or planning.
acceptance: Publisher queue ingests worker build/validation refs and worktree diff proofs.
Merge validator compares diffs for overlap/conflicts, reruns required audits/checks, and blocks unsafe merges.
Successful merges create local checkpoint/close commits with task/build/validation/tree proof.
Conflicts produce deterministic wait/reroute evidence and wake affected workers when resolved.
Tests cover clean merge, conflict, validation failure, stale base, close proof, and no remote publication without approval.
non_goals: Do not push to remote without explicit user approval.
Do not replace Git history as the source of merge truth.
Do not merge unvalidated worker outputs.

delta.desired: A merge/publisher agent serializes validated parallel outputs into safe commits.
delta.current: Publisher queue policy and role worktree proof exist, but merge orchestration for parallel worker diffs is not complete.
delta.closure: Close when merge queue behavior is implemented, tested, and task-close/publication proof gates pass.
